pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with varied geometry. Edges exhibit smooth to moderately defined pixel gradients rather than hard lines. Patches are significantly larger and more angular on the upper neck and mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented, and sub-rounded shapes on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is variable, widest between large flank patches and narrowing significantly in the more densely patterned posterior and ventral regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane visible along the dorsal neck line. The 1D silhouette displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.
